name: Bengaluru–Mysuru Infrastructure Corridor Peripheral Road

timeline.event: Karnataka government signs the framework agreement for the BMIC project
Peripheral and link toll roads begin opening to traffic in stages

history: The NICE Road is a private toll road that curves around the west and south of Bengaluru. It was built as the first part of a much bigger plan, the Bengaluru–Mysuru Infrastructure Corridor, which was meant to include a full private expressway to Mysuru. The expressway was never completed, but the peripheral road and a link road into the city opened in stages from the mid-2000s onwards. Today thousands of vehicles use it every day to skip the city's traffic while moving between the big highways that leave Bengaluru.
facts: A privately built and operated toll road, run by Nandi Infrastructure Corridor Enterprises (NICE).
Made up of a roughly 41 km peripheral road plus a link road of about 9 km towards the city.
Connects the roads leaving Bengaluru towards Tumakuru, Magadi, Mysuru, Kanakapura, Bannerghatta and Hosur.
Was planned as the first step of a 111 km private expressway to Mysuru that was never completed.
